headline: The Google TV Streamer now costs $50 more
summary: Google has increased the price of its 4K streaming box. The device now costs $149, up from its original $99. The price hike is live on Google Store and Best Buy.

headline: JMGO’s very bright all-in-one projector looks ideal for gamers and sports
summary: JMGO's 4K 120Hz Iris Ultra Max projector is now available globally. It boasts a 10,000:1 native contrast with a new dual-iris system. The projector is highlighted as ideal for gamers and sports enthusiasts.

headline: FTC lawsuit alleges Amazon has been ‘secretly and systematically’ overcharging for ads
summary: The FTC and 22 states are suing Amazon over alleged 'secret ad surcharges.' These surcharges supposedly inflated advertising prices on Amazon's platforms. Higher ad costs were likely passed on to American consumers.

headline: I went to the loneliest baseball game on Apple Vision Pro
summary: A reporter watched a baseball game using Apple Vision Pro VR. The immersive experience was technically impressive and visually remarkable. Despite the tech, the overall experience felt somewhat disconnected or 'lonely.'

headline: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups to Host a Retro Gaming ‘Fun House’ Activation at Westfield Parramatta This October
summary: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups are co-hosting a retro gaming event. The 'Fun House' activation will take place at Westfield Parramatta. The event is scheduled for October, celebrating retro gaming.

headline: Duane Davis Found Guilty in Murder of Tupac Shakur
summary: Duane Davis has been found guilty in the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur. The verdict comes nearly 30 years after Shakur's death. Tupac was killed in a 1996 Las Vegas drive-by shooting.

headline: Labor Day Sales Are Now Live — Here's Where You Can Find Deals Today
summary: Labor Day sales events are currently underway. Many retailers are offering significant deals and discounts. Consumers can find various sales live today.

headline: Save 70% Off Proton VPN's 2-Year Plan, Now Just $2.99
summary: Proton VPN is offering a 70% discount on its 2-year plan. The discounted price for the plan is now $2.99. This makes one of the 'best VPNs' currently on sale.

headline: Nepal death toll crosses 1,000 as rescuers race to find workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels
summary: Nepal's death toll has surpassed 1,000 after recent disasters. Rescuers are actively searching for workers trapped in mud-filled tunnels. Thousands remain missing, with additional fatalities reported in Tibet.

headline: Man charged with murder of woman and girl after fatal Teesside house fire
summary: A man has been charged following a fatal house fire in Teesside. A 7-year-old girl and her aunt died in the blaze. The tragic incident occurred in Grangetown, near Middlesbrough.

headline: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
summary: Six million deportees are being forced to return to Afghanistan under the Taliban. Many of these individuals have never lived in Afghanistan. An additional million have been deported from Pakistan and Iran this year alone.

headline: Ex-gang boss guilty of orchestrating 1996 murder of rapper Tupac Shakur
summary: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis was convicted for Tupac Shakur's 1996 murder. He was found guilty of orchestrating the drive-by shooting. The verdict closes a nearly 30-year-old case involving the rap superstar.
